BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13190.name: The TrueTwelveGodKing Exe-Gale-Ceed
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13190.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] [Seal: Seal] (When Attacks)
You can send [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Life.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] [True-Drive] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you've done so, at the end of a blocked battle, for each symbol on this Spirit, send an opposing Life to the Trash.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV2][LV3][LV4] [True-Soar] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, by paying one cost, this Spirit refreshes.

SJ17-01.name: The TwinkleBeastKing Blazoma
SJ17-01.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Ten Crown & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core](Soul Core) to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit and an opposing 10000 BP or less Ultimate.

[LV2] Flash - (When Attacks)
By discarding a pre-Advent card beneath this Spirit, summon a "God-King" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

SJ14-01.name: The UltimateStrongest Dragon
SJ14-01.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Red Spirits]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, the opponent must block if possible. However, opposing Ultimates don't have to block. If it's blocked by an opposing Spirit, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.
